DLA Weapons Support (Columbus) – is preparing to solicit a one-time buy for the following NSN:

NSN – 2805-01-555-6505 – ENGINE,OUTBOARD MUL

The currently approved manufacturer and associated part number for this item is as follows: BRP US Inc (CAGE 1UVT5) for Part Number E55MJRLAF.   Sources interested in becoming an approved source for this NSN must submit the appropriate information as outlined in DLAD Procurement Notes L04, Offers for Part Number Items and M06, Evaluation of Offers for Part Numbered Items.  Sources interested in offering on this solicitation should complete the attached market survey and return the completed copies to Cerita Sellers via email at cerita.sellers@dla.mil by 1:00 PM EST on 12 March 2026.
